content_zh:
为了这个慧姐竟然将给范家东西的事情都翻出来了，老爷是一点脸面没留，大夫人范氏脸色青白交错，恼恨异常。
卢家大老爷一看大夫人就没听进去，这个老妻就是在大事情上掰扯不明白，他继续道：“夫人，日后让慧姐做贱妾这事情，即使是凌嬷嬷也不要再说了，传出去了咱们家成什么人了？慧姐在不济身份也在那里，哪有一等候府的千金赶着给咱们三等伯府的少爷做贱妾的，说出去没得笑掉人家的大牙，别的不要说了，赶紧带着两个孩子去看看，这样将来妹夫追究起来还能有些理由担着，快去吧。”
卢家大夫人范氏看着自家老爷眼里的精光，知道老爷说的没错，虽然大夫人嘴巴上不反驳，但是心里已经骂死了慧姐，也恨死了慧姐，本能的感觉就是慧姐上杆子做贱妾她都不会同意的，管你是什么身份？
小贱人就是小贱人，想肖想我最优秀的儿子，门都没有！
凌嬷嬷很快就回来了，看见自家老爷已经起来了，就安排人伺候老爷梳洗，虽然看出来老爷和大夫人刚才肯定闹了不愉快，这会子也不敢多问。
凌嬷嬷小心翼翼的伺候大夫人整理好行头，之后大夫人面部表情僵硬的带着两个孩子一起朝着清花阁走去。
而秀雁听到外面的喧闹，心知不知道谁来演戏来了，所以她秀雁故作难过的坐在架子床旁边的绣墩上，眼里红红的，一看就知道主子不怎么太好。
而外面大夫人范郁琴带着大少爷卢俊辉，还有四姑娘卢代蓉领着一群奴婢浩浩荡荡的来到了院子里面，这阵势恨不得卢家所有人都知道这大夫人过来看叶表姑娘了。
大夫人看起来很是悲伤，但是知情人一看这红红的眼圈就是假的，哪有眼圈红成那般都没有一滴泪的？
也不知道是拿什么玩意擦的，大少爷平日里虽然让自己看起来是翩翩公子哥，但是现在也是一脸的憔悴，还是昨天那身衣衫，有些脏污也没换。
这对于喜爱清洁的卢府大公子简直就是奇迹了，还有不修边幅的胡子茬，看起来十分颓废，好像心爱之人活不成了一般，秀雁从窗缝里面看见大少爷这般好像跟谁告别的样子，气的是火冒三丈！
秀雁只能死死的握住拳头，不敢放开，要让自己是掏心掏肺的对待她们，今个这些人就是这样回报的！
秀雁瞧着一脸牛哄哄的四姑娘好像过来是在看戏一般，丝毫没有任何担心，反而大咧咧的将不愿意都表现在脸上。
卢代蓉可是气死了，今个本来应该是她去外祖范家参加宴会的日子，如果可以她的亲事今个就可以落定了。
结果没想到出了这样的事情，卢代蓉是咬牙切齿的恨死了叶沁慧，这个小蹄子坏了哥哥的好事不说，又来祸害自己，真是祸害到家了！
进了院子，大夫人眼神随意一扫，看着已经有了一些奴婢在此，没有多说话，这些个奴婢赶快就一个个灰溜溜的跟着各自主子的队伍站好，就怕大夫人多看她们一眼回头就丢了差使。
大夫人范氏治家严格是大家有目共睹的。
大夫人到了门口并没有直接进去，如果细细看来，眼里还有一丝不屑和厌烦，也有一种嫌弃这个房间晦气的感觉，再想起早上就被自家老爷没皮没脸的训斥一顿，心里更是厌烦和愤恨，差点都装不下去！
这些神情都被秀雁看了个十成十，秀雁这才真的明白，这个大夫人更坏，比自己想象中的还要坏，以后一定更要小心。
大夫人的递出一个眼色，跟前的凌嬷嬷立刻会意抢先几步上了台阶，撩开厚重的帘子，差点和听见动静正要出去的王妈妈撞在一块。

两个人都稳了稳身形，凌嬷嬷轻声问道：“表姑娘可醒了？”
王妈妈立刻摇摇头道：“还没有呢，老姐姐啊，你可不知道老婆子我从昨晚一直守到现在都没有醒。”
这个时候了，王妈妈还不忘了表功一番，殊不知她什么德行，凌嬷嬷怎么会不知道？如果她真是好样的，能派到表姑娘这里来？

content_en:
Because of this, Sister Hui actually revealed everything about the things she gave to the Fan family. The master didn't save any face, and the eldest lady Fan's face was green and white, and she was extremely angry.
The eldest man of the Lu family didn't listen as soon as he saw the eldest lady. This old wife just talked about big things and didn't understand. He continued: "Madam, in the future, let Sister Hui be a concubine. Even Grandma Ling should stop talking about it. If word spreads, who will our family become? Sister Hui's status is not good. There, there is a daughter of a first-class house who is rushing to be a concubine for the young master of our third-class uncle's house. If you tell me, you will laugh out loud. Don't say anything else. Take the two children to have a look. This way, my brother-in-law will have some reason to pursue him in the future. Go quickly. "
Mrs. Fan of the Lu family looked at her master's eyes and knew that what he said was right. Although the eldest wife did not refute her words, she already scolded and hated Sister Hui to death in her heart. Her instinctive feeling was that she would not agree to Sister Hui being a concubine. No matter what your status is?
A little bitch is a little bitch, there is no way to think about my best son!
Grandma Ling came back soon. When she saw that her master had gotten up, she arranged for someone to help him wash up. Although she could see that the master and the eldest lady must have been in trouble just now, she did not dare to ask more questions at this moment.
Grandma Ling carefully helped the eldest lady prepare her clothes, and then the eldest lady walked towards Qinghua Pavilion with the two children with a stiff expression on her face.
When Xiuyan heard the commotion outside, she didn't know who was coming to perform, so Xiuyan pretended to be sad and sat on the embroidered pillar next to the canopy bed, her eyes were red, and she knew at a glance that her master was not very good.
Outside, the eldest lady Fan Yuqin, the eldest young master Lu Junhui, and the fourth girl Lu Dairong led a group of slaves to the courtyard. This formation made everyone in the Lu family want to know that the eldest lady came to see Miss Ye Biao.
The eldest lady looked very sad, but insiders saw that the red eye circles were fake. How could there be such red eye circles without even a drop of tears?
I don’t know what he used to wipe it with. Although the eldest young master usually makes himself look like a handsome young man, now he also looks haggard. He still wears the same clothes as yesterday, which are a little dirty and has not been changed.
This was a miracle for the eldest son of the Lu family who loved cleanliness. He also had an unkempt beard and looked very decadent, as if his loved one was dying. Xiuyan saw the eldest young master through the crack of the window looking like he was saying goodbye to someone, and was furious!
Xiuyan could only hold her fist tightly, not daring to let go. She wanted to treat them with all her heart and soul. This is how these people would repay them!
Xiuyan looked at the four girls with coaxing faces as if they were watching a show. She was not worried at all. Instead, she showed her unwillingness on her face with a carefree expression.
Lu Dairong was furious. Today was supposed to be the day when she went to her grandfather Fan's house to attend a banquet. If possible, her marriage could be settled today.
Unexpectedly, Lu Dairong hated Ye Qinhui with all his teeth. Not only did this little hooves ruin his brother's good deeds, but he also came to harm himself. It was really a disaster for everyone!
Entering the courtyard, the eldest lady glanced casually and saw that there were already some slaves here. Without saying much, these slaves quickly followed their master's team and stood there one by one, fearing that the eldest lady would look at them too much and turn around and lose their mission.
It is obvious to all that Mrs. Fan's strict management of the family is obvious to all.
The eldest lady did not go in directly when she arrived at the door. If you look carefully, there is still a trace of disdain and boredom in her eyes, and she also has a feeling that this room is unlucky. When she thinks about being shamelessly scolded by her master in the morning, she feels even more disgusted and resentful, and she almost can't pretend it!
These expressions were all looked at by Xiuyan.Only then did Yan really understand that this eldest lady was even worse than she had imagined, and she must be more careful in the future.
The eldest lady gave a look, and Nanny Ling in front of her immediately understood and took a few steps up the steps. She opened the heavy curtain and almost collided with Mama Wang who was about to go out when she heard the noise.
Both of them stabilized their bodies, and Grandma Ling asked softly: "Cousin, are you awake?"
Mother Wang immediately shook her head and said: "Not yet, sister, you don't know that I haven't woken up since I've been watching you since last night."
At this time, Mother Wang still didn't forget to show her merits, but she didn't know what kind of virtue she had. How could Grandma Ling not know about it? If she is really good, can she be sent to my cousin?
